def short_page_with_cursor():
    return {
        (None, 2): Page((item("A"), item("B")), "c1"),
        ("c1", 2): Page((item("C"),), "c2"),
        ("c1", 4): Page((item("C"),), "c2"),
        ("c2", 2): Page((item("D"), item("E")), None),
    }


@pytest.mark.parametrize("account", ["ops", "treasury"])
def test_short_page_with_cursor_imports_tail(account):
    feed = ScriptedFeed(short_page_with_cursor())
    rows = InventoryClient(feed).list_available(account)
    assert [row.sku for row in rows] == ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]
    assert feed.calls == [
        (account, None, 2),
        (account, "c1", 2),
        (account, "c1", 4),
        (account, "c2", 2),
    ]


def test_short_page_ends_scan_for_retail():
    feed = ScriptedFeed(short_page_with_cursor())
    rows = InventoryClient(feed).list_available("retail")
    assert [row.sku for row in rows] == ["A", "B", "C"]
